title: Saudi Arabian Date Biryani
description: A traditional Saudi dish made with aromatic spices, fluffy rice, and sweet dates. This recipe is a delicious twist on the classic biryani.

ingredients.name: Heavenly saffron
ingredients.notes: soaked in 2 tablespoons of hot water

instructions: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain the water and set aside.
Heat the ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the saffron and its soaking water to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cardamom to the saucepan and cook for another minute.
Add the soaked rice to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
While the rice is cooking, heat a separate saucepan over medium heat.
Add the dates to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until they are softened.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and mix in the cooked dates.
Serve the Saudi Arabian Date Biryani hot, garnished with additional saffron threads if desired.
